summary.en: Navigate streets, bridges and hallways with gira a la izquierda, sigue todo recto and al lado de.

body.en:
From season 1, episode 4.

Sending Clara across Valencia for a brass boiler valve, Mateo maps every turn: *Gira a la izquierda al salir de nuestra puerta y sigue todo recto hasta el puente de piedra*, then *cruza el puente y luego pasa la farmacia verde a mano derecha*. Indoors, Clara places the rug *justo al lado de la cama*.

Three action verbs drive street directions in Spain: *gira* ('turn'), *sigue* ('continue / keep going'), and *cruza* ('cross'). Pair them with *a la izquierda* ('to the left'), *a la derecha* or *a mano derecha* ('on the right-hand side'), *todo recto* ('straight ahead'), and *hasta* ('up to / as far as').

For nearby landmarks, *cerca de* ('near') and *al lado de* ('next to') end in *de*—remembering to contract *de* + *el* into *del* before a masculine singular noun (*al lado del escritorio*, versus *al lado de la cama*).
